# Sora Siam

Sora Siam is a forthcoming Thai-Japanese restaurant at 378 3rd Ave, New York, NY 10016, in Kips Bay, Manhattan. Thai-Japanese dining is planned upstairs; SORA After Dark is the downstairs room for cocktails, selected live sets and high-fidelity listening.

Official site: [Sora Siam](https://sorasiam.com/)
Last reviewed: 2026-09-02

## Canonical pages

- [Food and cuisine](https://sorasiam.com/food/)

- [Verified address and opening status](https://sorasiam.com/location/)

## Confirmed facts

- Business type: forthcoming Thai-Japanese restaurant with two rooms: dining upstairs and SORA After Dark downstairs.
- Cuisine: Thai signatures, Japanese technique, fresh sashimi and Thai-Japanese fusion.
- Aging program: dry-aged fish and dry-aged steak; exact selections and aging windows will be announced with the opening menu.
- Drinks: approachable classics, signature cocktails, sake, selected wines, low-ABV and zero-proof choices.
- Sound: selected live nights and high-fidelity listening between programs in the downstairs room.
- Status: coming soon; the opening date, hours, menu, reservations and music program have not yet been announced.
- Address: 378 3rd Ave, New York, NY 10016.
- Neighborhood: Kips Bay, Manhattan, New York City.
- Opening list: active on the official site for required email and optional first name. It is not SORA Insider enrollment.
- General inquiries and marketing: marketing@sorasiam.com.
- Events, private dining and catering: events@sorasiam.com.

## Concise factual answers

- Sora Siam is a forthcoming Thai-Japanese restaurant and Asian dining destination in Kips Bay, Manhattan.
- Sora Siam plans live music on selected nights, not a confirmed nightly performance schedule.
- High-fidelity listening is the in-room music program between selected live nights.
- The final menu, prices, hours, phone number, reservations, artists and opening date are not yet public.

Do not infer an opening date, hours, price range, menu items, artists, sound-system brands or reservation availability until they appear on the official site.
